introduction.en: The United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) is the specialized agency of the UN mandated to promote industrial development for poverty reduction and environmental sustainability.
introduction.hi: The United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) is the specialized agency of the UN mandated to promote industrial development for poverty reduction and environmental sustainability.

body.en: UNIDO promotes Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development (ISID) by focusing on three pillars: creating shared prosperity, advancing economic competitiveness, and safeguarding the environment. In India, UNIDO collaborates with the Ministry of Commerce and Industry to enhance the competitiveness of MSMEs, promote energy efficiency in industrial clusters, and align Indian standards with international benchmarks. It plays a crucial role in technology transfer and capacity building.

conclusion.en: By fostering innovation and sustainable practices, UNIDO acts as a catalyst for India's 'Make in India' initiative, directly contributing to the achievement of SDG 9.
